title: Prove minimum binary carrier and native XOR bill for the integer-shear target
body:
PR3937 leaves open whether a noncommutative caller can preserve PR3905's integer-shear target B=X²Y². This package proves that the least binary module dimension detecting B is **three**, constructs the action through P1(F3), and prices its complete finite native endpoint. In the specified basis B is `b ^= c`: one XOR, with a second arbitrary dirty block untouched.

The representation preserves B but shortens the formal four-label expression to two labels. Each opaque label expands to two or three XORs, so the raw four/two-label bills are 10/5 XORs; cancellation gives the one-XOR native optimum. The separate literal M3(F2)-scalar boundary uses 18 dirty bits and three target XORs. There is no faithful encoding of the infinite source algebra, selected caller conversion, supplier inequality or new kappa. PR3905's original formal minimum remains valid.

## Scope and evidence

- Written universal proof: dimensions one and two kill B; the three-dimensional construction is a genuine action of the concrete integer group, not a proposed presentation.
- Source-bound verifier authenticates five retained files, checks all 576 SL2(F3) products, all 36 GL2 necessary-relation pairs, all 24 represented factors, and all 64 six-bit dirty inputs.
- Separate AI review reconstructs the action using a different implementation, classifies GL2 as S3, and searches all 168 GL3 truth tables to confirm the 2/3/1 XOR minima. It checks the complete columnwise 18-bit boundary and nine damaged-input cases normally and under optimized Python. No human or formal-kernel review is claimed.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay passes. Final committed-byte, source-history and read-only Git-free export receipts are recorded in the handoff; hosted checks are separate and pending at publication.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/sl2z-binary-carrier` (standard library; recorded checks take seconds).

Canonical main and relevant sources were refreshed before submission. The 05:57 UTC snapshot covered 649 open PR bodies including drafts, and the repository overlap helper was rerun. Live handoff prose and focused all-state searches were checked; complete Discussion/arbitrary-diff coverage is unclaimed. PR2599's full-stream faithfulness threshold, PR2620's GL2 actual-stream minima and PR2010's different SL2(F3) alphabet are credited and kept distinct. The selected orientation baseline remains unverified because its sparse closure is absent; no selected full cold replay is claimed.

Stop this finite-carrier investigation here. A useful next step needs an actual payload subspace, injective encoder/decoder and consumer, with conversion, storage, all dirty roles and return priced. Target detection alone does not retain the formal tariff. No continuing claim, merge or selected-frontier change.
